Name: Kigakeun's Harvey HD Anime Portrait (No Glasses - Glasses - Vanilla)
Author: Kigakeun
Description:
Created for my own game and felt like sharing. I made these portraits with the intention of trying to match other HD anime portrait packs such as [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15199]Anime HD Portraits[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15512]Anime HD SVE Portraits[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15671]HD Anime Ridgeside Village Portraits[/url].

Three versions available: Glasses, no glasses, and vanilla design.

[center]♡♡♡[/center]
[size=6][u][b]INSTALLATION:
[/b][/u][/size]1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url] and its requirements.
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24534]PortraiturePlus[/url].
(Portraiture currently does not support seasonal portraits - PortraiturePlus fixes this)﻿
3. Create a new folder inside [i]Mods\Portraiture\Portraits [/i]if you haven't already, titled whatever you want.
4. Extract the three downloaded .png files into the new folder.

[size=6][u][b]MODS SEEN IN SCREENSHOTS:[/b][/u][/size]﻿
♡ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6166]Overgrown Flowery Interface[/url]
♡ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20713]Farmer Portraits for 1.6[/url]
♡ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14643]Customizable Heart Relationship Icon[/url]
♡ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9859]JA Korokke's Uniforms Pack[/url]
♡ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2869]Coii's Hair Sets Pack[/url] 
♡ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6200]Life Cycle - Rival Heart Events[/url] 

[b][u][size=6]PERMISSIONS﻿:
[/size][/u][/b]Permissions are [b]OPEN[/b]. If you want to improve on my portraits or add more for other mods, please feel free!

Due to the mod author's rules, my portraits may NOT be used with the designs from [b]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/b]. You would need to come up with your own outfit designs to make a seasonal portrait expansion.
